sketches.mechanism: A constrained subtype is checked on assignment; assigning a value outside its declared range raises Constraint_Error.
sketches.resonance: A self bounded to exactly one value can only continue by becoming an error.

sketches.mechanism: Deferred calls run after the return statement and may still mutate named return values before the function actually exits.
sketches.resonance: The last touch revises the leaving, so departure is declared and then undone.

sketches.mechanism: The absurd pattern () discharges a case by proving that no value of an empty type can exist.
sketches.resonance: From a wound with no possible inhabitant, every promised answer is vacuously complete.
